newsitem.title: FRANCE: American delays ex-Paris rate rise to June.
newsitem.headline: American delays ex-Paris rate rise to June.

text.p: American Airlines, said it had postponed implementation of increases in its ex-Paris air cargo rates until the start of June.

"We had planned to introduce the increases from May 5 but this has been put back until June 2 as a result of re-structuring our overall pricing system," a Paris-based cargo official for the airline told Reuters.
American's ex-Paris rates to the U.S. will rise by an average of six percent, the official said.
The airline operates daily passenger services to New York, Chicago, Boston, Los Angeles and Dallas. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
